Audio audition

Open this file from art/ (the raw clips are read from art/vendor/, the built ones from art/build/audio/). Each sound ID shows the current pick(s) from art/audio.json and the plan's alternates (docs/FX_AUDIO.md). Measurements are of the raw clips: length, audible length (above -50 dB), sample peak, integrated loudness. Edit art/audio.json, set "confirmed": true once a pick is settled, then npm run audio:lock, npm run audio:build and npm run audio:audition.
